implemented: Native herdr open accepts original Claude terminals and composes model/effort arguments without stream-json launch switches.
Claude history root honors configured CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and explicit roots; initial prompts can precede transcript publication, with bounded discovery and durable provider-specific cache.

Append-only transcript reader binds exact request activation, session/workspace, file identity and connected message UUIDs. Queued prompts, sidechains, unrelated parents, duplicate UUID mutation, partial records and replaced/rewritten files cannot complete a request.
Assistant end_turn or exactly attributed turn_duration is a candidate; live Herdr identity and idle readiness plus a second transcript read are required before completion.
Hook feedback and tool results invalidate old completion candidates and prior assistant boundary identity.
Native single pasted_content envelope normalization preserves exact ID and rejects nested/sibling/mismatched envelopes; quoted requests are not activated.
Claude can act as Lead or Worker through the existing durable callback chain; cold recovery observes the existing execution without replay.
Stopped-server recovery retains Claude transcript bytes and resumes the same UUID with --resume.
Recovery completion is written before running becomes visible in the public open record.

red_findings: Deferred Claude tasks were blocked by the Store allow-list still restricting herdr-history.json to Codex; fixed and retested.
Broad 69-case run exposed running/reset publication race in stopped native Codex recovery. The final 21-case recheck passed after ordering repair.
A new deterministic unit test reproduced stale turn_duration resurrecting a hook-invalidated answer; cleared prior assistant identity on new input.
Native pasted_content wrapper was not recognized before normalization; positive/negative unit cases and both bound/deferred integration variants now pass.
fixture_repairs: Initial five errors were a fixture layout still declaring worker:codex after changing the compiled provider to Claude; setup finalizer added for dummy-process cleanup.
Two public-open test failures omitted .ccb/ccb.config required by project discovery; fixture now creates it.

sanitized_real_transcript.mode: prior authenticated stream-json run, not an original TUI capture

actual_herdr_acceptance.instruction: If the check fails, say that you are not running inside Herdr and stop. Do not inspect or control the focused Herdr session from outside Herdr.

limits: Herdr control-plane behavior in these tests is a fixture; some existing Codex host regression cases use the actual installed Codex CLI without model inference.
Original Claude terminal rendering, real Herdr detection, actual permission dialogs, manual context changes and cancellation still require frontend acceptance.
Unexpected transcript formats, changed identities and uncertain sends remain faults/unknown outcomes, never permission to replay.
Discovery and transcript processing are bounded; large-history latency and broader platform/legacy coexistence remain rollout gates.
The full Rust migration and production/default promotion are not complete.
